title: A Unified Attack Framework against Statistical Generative Watermarks for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27653v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Watermarking has emerged as a key tool for identifying text generated by large language models (LLMs), with current schemes embedding statistical signals into the generation process to enable later detection. In this work, we identify a shared weakness across a broad class of popular LLM watermarking methods, including KGW (and its variants), GumbelSoft, DipMark, ITS, and SynthID. We show that these schemes exhibit a fundamental link between their detection scores and the token probability shifts they introduce during generation. This link, which we call score-ratio alignment, allows an attacker with only black-box query access to the model--and no knowledge of secret keys or model weights--to produce text that evades detection while remaining fluent and natural. translated_title: 针对大语言模型统计生成式水印的统一攻击框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：水印技术已成为识别大语言模型（LLM）生成文本的关键工具，现有方案通过在生成过程中嵌入统计信号来实现后续检测。在这项工作中，我们识别出一大类流行的LLM水印方法（包括KGW及其变体、GumbelSoft、DipMark、ITS和SynthID）的共同弱点。我们证明这些方案的检测分数与其在生成过程中引入的token概率偏移之间存在根本性联系。我们将这种联系称为“分数-比率对齐”，它使得仅拥有模型黑盒查询访问权限的攻击者——无需知晓密钥或模型权重——就能生成既逃避水印检测又保持流畅自然的文本。我们证明由此产生的攻击在所有所涵盖的水印家族中都是最优的，并表明这一弱点是内在的：任何旨在最大化统计……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该研究揭示了主流大语言模型统计水印方法（如KGW、SynthID等）存在“分数-比率对齐”的固有弱点，并提出一个仅需黑盒查询、无需密钥即可生成逃避检测的流畅文本且在这些水印家族中理论最优的统一攻击框架。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals an intrinsic "score-ratio alignment" weakness shared by mainstream statistical LLM watermarking schemes and proposes a unified, provably optimal black-box attack framework that generates fluent, detection-evading text without needing secret keys.
